# Supreme Cuts Barbershop

> Walk-in barbershop based in Austin, Texas. Clean fades, sharp lineups and razor designs on South 1st Street. Walk in any day of the week, grab a red chair, and leave fresh.

- Phone: (512) 373-3103
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Nearby areas: Austin, Sunset Valley, Manchaca, Buda, Kyle
- Google rating: 4.6 from 162 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/barbershops/texas/supreme-cuts-barbershop/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/barbershops/texas/supreme-cuts-barbershop/book.html

## Services
- Fades: Bald fades, taper fades and razor fades, blended clean and finished with a sharp lineup.
- Shear cuts & edge ups: Scissor work, slick backs, undercuts and line-ups for when you just need it tightened up.
- Hair designs & braids: Razor-cut designs and the braids the neon sign on the wall is all about.
- Beard trims: Beard shaping and clean necklines to match the cut.
- Hot towel shaves: The old-school hot towel shave, finished with a straight razor in a red leather chair.
- Kids' cuts: Dads and sons get cut together here, even the morning of a wedding. Kids are always welcome.

## About
Supreme Cuts is a walk-in barbershop on South 1st Street in South Austin. Look for the red BARBER SHOP letters out front and the services painted right on the window: bald fades, taper fades, razor fades, shear cuts, edge ups, beard trims and hot towel shaves. Inside it's white walls and red everything: red leather chairs down a long row, red trim along the ceiling, the box-logo on every station, Monopoly-man art on the walls and a red neon sign that says Braids & Fades. Customers talk about the vibe as much as the cuts: chill, friendly, laid back, real Austin. Barbers like Zay and Adam get named in the reviews again and again, and families bring the kids in together.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do I need an appointment?
  A: No. Supreme Cuts is a walk-in barbershop. Come in any day of the week, or call (512) 373-3103 to check the wait.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Thursday and Sunday 8 AM to 8 PM, Friday and Saturday 8 AM to 7 PM. Holiday hours can change, so call ahead if you're not sure.
- Q: Where is the shop?
  A: 6104 S 1st St #105, Austin, TX 78745, in South Austin. Look for the red BARBER SHOP sign and the services listed on the windows.
- Q: Do you cut kids' hair?
  A: Yes. Kids' cuts are welcome, and plenty of dads bring their sons in together.
- Q: Do you do designs and braids?
  A: Yes. Razor-cut hair designs and braids. Bring a photo of what you want.
- Q: Do you do beards and shaves?
  A: Yes. Beard trims, clean necklines and hot towel shaves.
